📖 How to use

  1. Your own user-agent string is parsed automatically on load.
  2. Paste any other UA string to parse it instead.
  3. Read the browser, version, OS, device and engine breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does browser detection work?

Detection order matters: Edge and Opera both contain 'Chrome' in their UA, so the parser checks Edg/OPR tokens before Chrome, and CriOS/FxiOS for iOS variants.

Is UA parsing 100% reliable?

No. User-agent strings can be spoofed or frozen (Chrome's UA reduction), so treat the result as a hint, not proof.

Can I parse a different UA string?

Yes — paste any UA string into the box and the parse updates live.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
